cause_quote: The commit routed configured binaries through `ensureManagedCrabboxBinary` and added `const VERSION_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000`, so a healthy executable whose version probe exceeded five seconds fell through to managed installation.
user_saw: During a busy Gateway startup, cloud workers could use an older managed Crabbox CLI in place of the healthy newer CLI the operator configured.
summary: The fix raises the Crabbox version-probe timeout to 30 seconds and combines remote commands for project preparation and snapshot capture.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its removed code, which show that Linux worker provisioning previously used the configured executable directly without a mandatory version probe. The live trace reported in the fix PR showed that a healthy 6.922-second probe selected managed 0.56 in place of configured 0.64. The remote-command reductions are performance improvements alongside that regression fix.
